source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 星宇股份解聘百名应届生 HR总监停职
topics.official_english: Xingyu Co. dismisses over 100 fresh graduates; HR director suspended
topics.why_hot: During the peak season for new graduates entering the workforce, reports of a company dismissing over 100 fresh graduates and suspending its HR director triggered public concern about campus recruitment integrity and labor rights.
topics.share_angle: Frame the incident as a case study of campus recruitment in China, including what happens when job offers are withdrawn and what legal protections graduates have.

topics.chinese_topic: 伊朗：霍尔木兹海峡临时航线谅解达成
topics.official_english: Iran says understanding reached on temporary routes in Strait of Hormuz
topics.why_hot: The Strait of Hormuz is a key global energy shipping lane; any change in routing can affect oil markets and regional geopolitics.
topics.share_angle: Explain the strategic importance of the Strait of Hormuz and what temporary shipping routes mean for global energy prices.

topics.chinese_topic: 央媒5问“店主帮扶老人遭索赔”事件
topics.official_english: Central media asks five questions about shop owner who helped elderly man then faced compensation claim
topics.why_hot: The case mixes a Good Samaritan act with a compensation demand, and central media's five questions made it a national debate about helping the elderly.
topics.share_angle: Use the incident to explain China's Good Samaritan laws and the wider public debate over helping elderly people in emergencies.

topics.chinese_topic: 重庆渝中警方：两名行人疑似触电昏迷
topics.official_english: Chongqing Yuzhong police: two pedestrians in suspected electric shock are in coma
topics.why_hot: The police statement about two pedestrians in suspected electric shock sparked public concern over urban electrical safety.
topics.share_angle: Use the police update to explain how city infrastructure can pose electric shock risks and what safety measures are under discussion.

topics.chinese_topic: 人民日报评“大学生家长群”
topics.official_english: People's Daily comments on 'college student parent groups'
topics.why_hot: People's Daily's commentary on parent groups in universities refocused attention on whether college students need parental supervision.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the phenomenon of university 'parent groups' in China and what it reveals about parenting and student independence.

topics.chinese_topic: 请3天假休13天 机票搜索热度大涨
topics.official_english: Taking three days off creates 13-day break; flight search heat surges
topics.why_hot: Netizens discovered that using three days of leave could create a 13-day holiday, causing a spike in flight searches and fueling travel-planning discussions.
topics.share_angle: Show how Chinese employees plan holidays by combining annual leave with public holidays and how that boosts travel bookings.

topics.chinese_topic: 游客因台风被困广西涠洲岛6天
topics.official_english: Tourists stranded on Guangxi's Weizhou Island for 6 days by typhoon
topics.why_hot: Bad weather left tourists trapped on Weizhou Island for nearly a week, drawing attention to typhoon preparedness and travel safety.
topics.share_angle: Tell the story from the traveler's perspective and use it to explain how typhoon season affects tourism on southern Chinese islands.

topics.chinese_topic: 武汉轮椅老人上高架蓄意碰瓷不实
topics.official_english: Claim that elderly wheelchair user on Wuhan elevated road staged a crash is false
topics.why_hot: A video of an elderly wheelchair user on an elevated road triggered suspicions of insurance fraud, but the claim was later debunked, prompting talk about online rumors.
topics.share_angle: Use the viral but false accusation as an entry point to discuss misinformation and the dangers of judging from edited clips.
